# Phone Use

> Cloud phones for AI agents. One open-source CLI (phone-use) creates an iOS
> simulator or an Android emulator in the cloud and gives agents the same
> verbs on both platforms through the CLI, an MCP server, and a TypeScript SDK
> (@phone-use/sdk). Agents read the screen as named elements, and every action
> reports whether the screen changed. Distinctives: deterministic map-powered
> navigation (goto/ask/toggle with zero model calls), replayable skills, an
> un-overridable destructive-action permission floor, a live browser viewer,
> and portable trace artifacts. No Mac needed for cloud phones.

## Install

- CLI and MCP server (macOS or Linux): `curl -fsSL https://phoneuse.dev/install | bash` (installs Bun >= 1.3 if missing, then the CLI; re-run to update)
- With Bun >= 1.3 already installed: `npm install -g phone-use` or `bun add -g phone-use`
- SDK (Node >= 22 or Bun): `npm install @phone-use/sdk`
- Check your setup: `phone-use doctor`

## Cloud phones

- `phone-use login` — sign in from the browser (or approve a code at app.phoneuse.dev/device)
- `phone-use create ios` / `phone-use create android` — create a cloud phone; iOS starts warm in about 2s
- `eval "$(phone-use env <id>)"` — attach the shell, so every verb targets that phone
- `phone-use list` / `phone-use close <id>` — list or close phones; 1h default lifetime (up to 24h with --ttl), closes after 15 min idle
- `phone-use install ./App.app` — install an iOS simulator build on the attached phone
- Watch any phone in the console at app.phoneuse.dev (live video on iOS, screenshots on Android)

## Agents

- Any MCP client: `npx -y phone-use mcp`, with PHONE_USE_SANDBOX_URL and PHONE_USE_SANDBOX_TOKEN set for a cloud phone (the console prints the config)
- Claude Code: `claude mcp add --scope project phone-use -- npx -y phone-use mcp`
- Built-in agent: `phone-use task "<goal>"` (needs ANTHROPIC_API_KEY)
- Shell verbs: `phone-use observe | tap | type | scroll | goto | ask | toggle | search | skill | atlas`;
  `--json` prints a machine-readable envelope; exit codes: 0 ok, 1 failed, 2 blocked, 3 confirmation required

## Local devices

- Without a cloud phone attached, the CLI drives a local iOS Simulator (macOS with Xcode) or an Android emulator over adb (`phone-use connect android`)
